propositions.name: ether_exists
propositions.statement: How far the ether is carried along by the earth is an important question that experiment can decide.
propositions.quote: the important question as to how far the ether is carried along by the earth

propositions.name: michelson_morley_experiment_exists
propositions.statement: The experiment of Michelson and Morley is a wonderfully delicate experiment attempting to decide the important question.
propositions.quote: I have read with much interest Messrs. Michelson and Morley 's wonderfully delicate experiment attempting to decide the important question

propositions.name: michelson_morley_result_opposed
propositions.statement: Their result seems opposed to other experiments.
propositions.quote: Their result seems opposed to other experiments showing that the ether in the air can be carried along only to an inappreciable extent.

propositions.name: ether_in_air_carried_inappreciably
propositions.statement: The ether in the air can be carried along only to an inappreciable extent.
propositions.quote: the ether in the air can be carried along only to an inappreciable extent

propositions.name: hypothesis_needed_to_reconcile_opposition
propositions.statement: Almost the only hypothesis that can reconcile this opposition is that the length of material bodies changes.
propositions.quote: I would suggest that almost the only hypothesis that can reconcile this opposition is that the length of material bodies changes

propositions.name: material_bodies_have_length
propositions.statement: Material bodies have length.
propositions.quote: the length of material bodies changes, according as they are moving through the ether or across it

propositions.name: length_changes_with_motion
propositions.statement: The length of material bodies changes according as they are moving through the ether or across it.

propositions.name: contraction_direction_dependent

propositions.name: contraction_quadratic_in_velocity
propositions.statement: The amount changes depending on the square of the ratio of their velocity to that of light.
propositions.quote: by an amount depending on the square of the ratio of their velocity to that of light

propositions.name: light_has_velocity

propositions.name: electric_forces_affected_by_motion
propositions.statement: We know that electric forces are affected by the motion of the electrified bodies relative to the ether.
propositions.quote: We know that electric forces are affected by the motion of the electrified bodies relative to the ether

propositions.name: electrified_bodies_exist
propositions.statement: There are electrified bodies, and their motion is relative to the ether.

propositions.name: molecular_forces_affected_by_motion

propositions.quote: it seems a not improbable supposition that the molecular forces are affected by the motion

propositions.name: size_alters_due_to_motion
propositions.statement: The size of a body alters consequently.
propositions.quote: the molecular forces are affected by the motion, and that the size of a body alters consequently

propositions.name: electrical_attraction_experiments_important
propositions.statement: It would be very important if secular experiments on electrical attractions between permanently electrified bodies were instituted.
propositions.quote: secular experiments on electrical attractions between permanently electrified bodies, such as in a very delicate quadrant electrometer, were instituted

propositions.name: quadrant_electrometer_delicate

propositions.name: attraction_varies_diurnally_and_annually
